title: selftest: vacuous pass if WOLF_CRYPTO2DEV_DEVID unregistered
description: wc_crypto2dev_selftest() checks g_pool_inited but NOT that WOLF_CRYPTO2DEV_DEVID is in g_devid_table. Trigger: wc_crypto2dev_init() + wc_crypto2dev_register_ex(MY_ID) (not registering WOLF_CRYPTO2DEV_DEVID) + wc_crypto2dev_selftest(). Outcome: wc_AesInit(&aes, NULL, WOLF_CRYPTO2DEV_DEVID) sets devId but CryptoCb has no callback for it; every AesGcmEncrypt returns CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE and falls through to software. Software oracle and 'hardware' both use software; comparison passes; selftest returns 0 without ever touching hardware. Fix: add crypto2dev_find_devid(WOLF_CRYPTO2DEV_DEVID) check at selftest entry.
